description: Active FAA NOTAMs (Notices to Air Missions) for a US airport or facility from the FAA's public NOTAM Search: NOTAM number, type (aerodrome, procedure, obstruction, airspace...), effective from/to times in UTC, permanent or estimated end, ICAO text and plain-language text, plus counts by type. US (FAA) locations only; 30 NOTAMs per page; not for flight planning. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

location.description: ICAO or FAA location id, e.g. KJFK, JFK, KORD, ZNY

type.description: Optional filter on the NOTAM type, e.g. aerodrome, procedure, obstruction, airspace
